faqs.a:
The planning commission shall have power to prepare a comprehensive plan as a guide
               for future zoning and rezoning and shall have lawful and comprehensive studies made
               in conjunction therewith. Any plan so prepared shall be made with the general purpose
               of carrying out the objective of providing for the planning, and orderly physical
               development of the city and applicable surrounds.
(Code 1960, § 2-24; Code 1981, § 25-34; Ord. No. 2498, § 1, 3-7-1988)
State Law reference—
Comprehensive plan, C.R.S. § 31-23-303.
